_comment: Behavioral-eval fixture for /marketing:import-campaign (BC-12943, ADR-028 Phase-2 Batch B — structure-first manifest composer). A SCENARIO MATRIX driven through the REAL runtime entrypoint `import_campaign.py compose` (PURE stdin→stdout, no clock — created_at is an INPUT) against a FROZEN copy of the canonicals _manifest.yaml taxonomy in import-campaign-seed/. The structure-first proof: the COMPOSED v2 manifest's deterministic structure — the 13-key top level, schema_version 2, the scaffolded_by literal, the input passthroughs, and the email_bison.campaigns[] records WITH their auto-classified audience_tier objects (longest-token-wins over the taxonomy) + the derived pending_classification flag — and, for rejection rows, the builder-owned input-guard error. Each payload is the literal compose stdin; the success payloads come from the proven test_import_campaign.sh scenarios B/C/D/J/R; the rejections from E/G/Q1 (three distinct guard surfaces: slug validator, per-record workspace validator, non-dict shape guard).

scenarios.note: cohort-1 shape: empty eb_records[] → schema_version 2, scaffolded_by literal, email_bison.campaigns []  (NOT the v1 singular campaign_id), salesforce.campaign_id null. Exercises the 13-key top level + the v1-anti-regression invariant.

ONE launched record whose name carries 'Managers+ | Professional Emails' → the auto-classifier resolves tier=professional + seniority=managers-plus (longest-token-wins actually RUNS here), status + launched_at preserved, NO pending_classification. The classification assertion is load-bearing ONLY on a record-bearing row.

eb_records.name: FY25, M09 | Bars | Managers+ | Professional Emails | All ESPs

scenarios.note: 3 records across both workspaces + 3 distinct tiers (general / professional / personal) + the typo-tolerant 'Bars Owners, GMs' seniority match. Locks campaigns[] ORDER + per-record classification + pending_classification ABSENT on all 3.

eb_records.name: FY25, M09 | Bars | Bar Owners, GMs | General Emails
FY25, M09 | Bars | Managers+ | Professional Emails | All ESPs
FY25, M09 | Bars | Bars Owners, GMs | Personal Emails

scenarios.note: a launched record EB returns with a blank/whitespace name → the classifier can't resolve it → the helper stamps a placeholder tier=professional (seniority null) AND sets pending_classification:true so it surfaces for operator review. THE derived-flag SET path (the twin of single_launched's absence assertion).

a record carrying an explicit operator audience_tier {role, null, [reverified]} + a name the classifier would NOT match → the override is passed through verbatim (the classifier is bypassed). Guards the override branch + its shape-validation.

eb_records.name: Some Free-Form String The Classifier Won't Match

scenarios.note: slug 'Bad_Slug_Underscore' fails the campaign-slug regex → rc 1, stderr names the slug validator. ok:false + the error string; manifest null. The slug guard is first in compose's order.

valid top-level fields BUT a per-record workspace 'emailbison-broken' → rc 1, the per-record validator fires (distinct from the top-level eb_workspace path, which stays valid). Isolates the eb_record.workspace guard.

a non-dict eb_records element (123) → rc 1 with a CLEAN 'eb_record must be an object' error, NOT a Python traceback (the BC-12xxx P1 regression lock). Isolates the shape guard / the (ValueError,KeyError,TypeError) backstop.
